construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch for this build

input.query: required nonempty string with word tokens, maximum 500 characters
input.products: required list, maximum 1000; unique trimmed string id and title required; description string and tags list optional
input.semantic_weight: optional number 0..1, default 0; positive value requires injected Python embedder

shared_schema.success: status=ok, dataset_label, query, matches[{id,title,score,lexical_score,semantic_score,matched_terms}], total_matches, index{product_count,term_count}, ranking{method,semantic_weight}
shared_schema.error: status=error, error{code,message}; CLI exits 2 and prints one JSON object
shared_schema.validation: Shared validation helpers used by request and embedding paths; unknown fields, duplicate IDs/JSON keys, invalid numbers and nonstandard JSON rejected

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated request -> product-ID-sorted in-memory inverted index
Casefolded Unicode word tokens -> BM25 lexical scores
Optional injected query/document vectors -> validated normalized cosine similarities
Weighted score blend -> deterministic ranked shared response

behavior.lexical: BM25 k1=1.2, b=0.75, positive IDF; score transformed as x/(1+x). Title, description and tags indexed together. Repeated query terms deduplicated.
behavior.embedding_interface: search(payload, embedder=callable). One batch containing query then product texts in ID order. Return list of equal-dimensional nonzero finite numeric vectors, dimensions 1..4096. No live provider. Weight 0 disables callback; empty corpus skips it.
behavior.ranking: (1-weight)*lexical + weight*max(0,cosine); positive scores retained, rounded to 6 decimal places; descending rounded score then ascending product ID; limit after ranking
behavior.empty_results: Valid empty corpus or no positive matches returns status ok and empty matches
behavior.fixtures: All example products and deterministic embedding test vectors are explicitly synthetic
